text_block_list.text:
Continuing to run alongside <chrname>,
the months and years flew by in the blink of an eye.
And—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Tidings of good fortune!
I bring excellent news!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your trainee Umamusume's
achievements were recognized—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!! Entry into the 'URA Finals'
has officially been decided!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it!
I'm the one who should be thanking you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"To my expectations that you would
raise a star Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!
She truly delivered on expectations!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If an Umamusume who captures the hearts of so many people runs,
the race is bound to be thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The "URA Finals" will surely become a dream stage for everyone to enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Full marks! You delivered results far beyond anything I could have imagined!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With countless cheers echoing across the track,
the race is bound to be a massive hit!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With your trainee running, there's no way
the URA Finals could end in failure!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...And one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "It is precisely because of your cooperation that we were able to make it this far."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Along the "URA Finals" course, when you called out to them—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And the lush, green turf cultivated by
so many people shall sway in the wind!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Many thanks! Profound thanks!!
Thank you very, very much!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: “—The URA Finals are right around the corner! I expect nothing less than your best run!”
choice_data_list: I'll make this a race that stays in everyone's memories!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Become the role models
and inspirations for the Umamusume who follow after you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations,
Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...*clap clap*.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Actually... we were able to enter the race too.
We just received the notification a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Peace.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Together with Meek, I will undoubtedly seize the crown of glory.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: And... as your Trainer, I'll grow enough so that I won't lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Not just begging to learn from you...
I want to become someone who can stand right beside you.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I can become one.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Neither to you, nor to the Umamusume you train.
...I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...My Trainer is incredible, after all.
............Smug."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you, Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Trainer <username>!
Let us make our Umamusume shine together!
And so, participation in the "URA Finals"—where the finest and fiercest contenders gather—was officially decided!
